about_teaser.heading: The next phase of fintech growth comes from working together.
about_teaser.lead: FCC started as IAMAI's fintech committee and launched as the Fintech Convergence Council in 2018. Today it brings banks, NBFCs, insurers, investment platforms and fintechs into one room, and carries their shared view to regulators.
